target: G3, native final grade from 0 to 20
forecast_origin: After G2 is available; questionnaire timing is unverified, so extended-feature analyses are retrospective
estimator: L2-regularized all-threshold ordinal logistic regression (mord.LogisticAT), labels ordered by observed native grade; point forecast is probability-weighted native grade
outer_validation: 5-fold shuffled KFold, independently per subject, same folds for every model
inner_validation: 3-fold KFold inside each training fold; select alpha minimizing point-forecast MAE; StandardScaler fitted inside each fit
primary_metric: MAE in native grade points (0 to 20)
improvement_event: G3 >= G2 + 2; two native points is an analysis threshold, not a school achievement level
uncertainty: 2000 paired student bootstraps of fixed out-of-fold errors; conditional on the fitted folds, not full model-refit uncertainty
stress_test: Train on one school, evaluate on the other, both directions; inner tuning within the training school only
sensitivity: Report errors on G3=0 and G3>0 separately, without excluding any records from main evaluation
permutation_importance: Extended model, held-out outer-fold feature permutations, 10 repetitions; association, not intervention effect
leakage_controls: No joint training or pooling across subjects: 382 students overlap
No scaler or tuning fitted on outer test data
No model/feature changes selected after inspecting outer-test scores
limitations: Portuguese secondary students aged 15-22, not Peruvian primary pupils
Final G3 is a final-year assessment and may incorporate earlier performance
Only two schools and no calendar-year or tutor intervention data
No within-skill attempts, hints, retention probes or school competency rubrics
Ordinal probabilities require prospective calibration before operational use
Observational associations do not identify causes
